verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Floating in the Pacific Ocean on Friday... waters off San Diego... at 8:07 p.m. Eastern time'; R2: 'splashed down in the Pacific Ocean, about 40 to 50 miles off the coast of San Diego... 8:07 p.m. ET'; R3: 'splash down in the Pacific Ocean about 50 miles off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. ET on April 10'; R5: 'splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego... 8:07 p.m. EDT / 5:07 PDT'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly confirm the location (Pacific off San Diego, CA), date (April 10, 2026), and exact time (8:07 p.m. ET/Eastern).
